observations.body: On the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples ask where to prepare; Jesus directs them to a man in the city, and they prepare the Passover.
observations.label: The disciples prepare the Passover at Jesus’ direction

observations.body: The passage presents Preparing the Passover as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Preparing the Passover

observations.body: The passage places First day of unleavened bread beside Preparing the Passover.
observations.label: First day of unleavened bread

payload.posture: Read Matthew 26:17–19 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples ask where to prepare; Jesus directs them to a man in the city, and they prepare the Passover. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: The disciples prepare the Passover at Jesus’ direction
